d:
Radhika panch sal pahle likhna parhna bhul gaee thin. ye korona ka daur tha. ab panch sal bad bibisi ne radhika se phir mulakat ki hai. radhika bari klas men aa gaee hain. par kya parhne, likhne par jo asar panch sal pahle tha, vo ab bhi kayam hai?
Radhika parhne likhne men aaj jaisi hain, uski kaee vajhen hain. kya hain vo vajhen, ye riport men dekhie aur hamen bhi bataie.
Bharat men ejukeshan sistam par ye hai bibisi ki khas siriz. aaj is siriz ke pahle episod men aap radhika se milie...
Riport- divya aary aur rubaiyat bisvas
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
